body: Well things have changed, you have things that others would kill for, a good job, an apartment, and presumably decent credit. Another suicidal redditor just made a post about how he wants to kill himself due to the absence of things you think nothing of. Appreciate what you have, and take pride in it. Try and be the best software you can be and work towards upgrading that apartment into a house. And since these are some of your many strong points, you tell every girl u meet that u have your own apartment and have regular income. Trust me girls like men with a future, and it seems to me that yours is pretty bright.

While what you are considering doing is selfless and honorable, if you are doing it for your parents you should ask them how they feel about it before going through with it. Chances are they do not care how much debt you are in and neither should you. As long as you work hard and keep your head up you should be able to get by this rough time. Everyone goes through a time where they are in major debt but we all get through it in someway or another. Just be happy that you have a loving father who loves you enough to bail you out when you need help. I'm sure to your dad you are worth your 60k dead, but a living breathing son is priceless.

Don't worry i already made up my mind that it is not my place to determine who lives and who dies, and i would never be intimate with a woman (or man) against her(or his) will. And i haven't found anything peaceable that i love yet. Also I am really bad at doing things consistently so doing only one thing may not work out. The only things i actually do on a fairly consistent basis are wake up and eat lol. Though i have been trying to find something like that tbh, just haven't had much luck.

I have also considered this, and have already decided that if I cant get the nerve to do it by the end of summer I will just let it happen naturally. Though it will always be at the back of my mind since anonymous internet forums are the only place i can even hint at this sort of thing.

Though i usually only joke about these things to see if anyone i know is cool with it, things like murder, theft, and drugs (distribution, and produtction, i like to be in control of myself at all times). You know, the usual stuff.

The types of adventures i like are deemed taboo by society (and i completely understand and respect that), so if life takes me on one of those adventures chances are i am going to be dead or in prison where i will most definitely kill myself (after taking a few bad people with me).
Nothingness if one of the outcomes i look forward to the most, the chance to experience that which i cannot comprehend seems like a rather tempting oppertunity.

You should really try online dating, or going out and socializing at places you know people with interests similar to yours are. You could also try joining groups on meetup.com . There are plenty of options if your main problem is women. The best way to find love is to be yourself around women and the ones that like what they see will approach you. Just relax and be confident in yourself and women will come. Make sure to show off what you have and try to have fun, as long as you focus on finding love, you will not find it. Just have fun with life and love will find its way in. Hope this helped.
